purpose: pre-verify, before any multi-hour proving burn, that a systemd user unit with the proof unit's environment can reach Docker for the final Groth16 wrap

probe1.wrapper: none (plain env, mirroring the v1 packet construction)
key_journal_lines: permission denied while trying to connect to the docker API at unix:///var/run/docker.sock
probe1.root_cause: systemd user transient units do not carry the supplementary docker group (988); the docker client gets EACCES on /var/run/docker.sock. This is the exact mechanism of the v1 run's final-wrap failure (docker.rs:29).

probe2.wrapper: sg docker -c (restores supplementary docker group inside the unit)
probe2.environment: PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin, SP1_GNARK_IMAGE=ghcr.io/succinctlabs/sp1-gnark:v6.1.0; DOCKER_HOST unset so the default socket /var/run/docker.sock is used; identical env construction to the proof unit command in scripts/a666-r4-receipt-prover-docker-refire

fix_adopted: proof unit command wrapped in sg docker -c in scripts/a666-r4-receipt-prover-docker-refire (fire path and rendered command)
